mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals weakening consumer demand and rising recession risk, which increases the probability of negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals deteriorating household demand, which increases the probability of negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling RSAFS and HOUST (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity and lower corporate earnings, which increases the probability of negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling INDPRO (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor demand and higher corporate earnings, which increases the probability of positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising PAYEMS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals deteriorating aggregate demand, which increases the probability of negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling RSAFS and INDPRO (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) below 2% signals easing inflationary pressure and a lower probability of aggressive Fed tightening, which increases the probability of positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of CPIAUCSL < 2% (t-test p > 0.05).
